_comment: Step 2.5 (ADR-0013). Replace https://api.example.com with API_PUBLIC_URL and app.example.com with the web app host (it must match FRONTEND_URL / TASK_URL_TEMPLATE). Paste at api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From a manifest. Then copy Client ID/Secret and the Signing Secret into SLACK_CLIENT_ID, SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET, SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.
